patch_description: The best previous program (score 0.99, sum 2.61) combined the multi-seed constructor with an SLSQP continuous refinement of the joint (centers, radii) variables. The current program dropped SLSQP entirely and regressed to 0.92. Restore the SLSQP polishing stage, and improve on it by polishing the top-k constructor candidates (not just the single best), since SLSQP is basin-sensitive: different starting layouts converge to different local optima. The SLSQP result is always re-validated/repaired via grow_radii, so validity stays 1.0.
